title: My pot has defects, pot holes and enamel bubbles around the bottom! Lid is ok
text:
My pot has defects, pot holes and enamel bubbles around the bottom! Lid is ok. This is a heavy cast iron enamel 5qt pot with A lid you can also use on the stove or oven.
I ordered this large pot for baking sourdough bread, and other types of bread.

That said, this beautiful pot has Defects that shows to me it can’t be used for long!

The enamel around the inside bottom sides has pin holes, and the enamel is thickly bubbled!
The pin holes will start the cast iron to get rusty underneath, and the bubbles will start to chip open.

Very disappointing, as this defect can also happen in expensive cast iron enamel,
Although it’s rare.
In less expensive cast iron enamel there is a better chance of
This type of sloppy work!

I do have two other cast iron enamel pots that where not expensive also, but do not
Have this defect. One does not have a name I bought from Amazon! And the other bigger oval one, is AmazonBasics.

Check your pot for defects before using it. This is a worthless pot to me now.
